title: Lapsed Tire Order Cancellation and Refund — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Lapsed tire orders — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty

A Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set that still stands in status ordered, never mounted, past the end of its hold period counted from its purchase date (the line's hold after purchase, in calendar days) is cancelled by the store without a request, and a lapsed-order refund is paid back to the tender that paid the ticket. The cancellation moves the set from status ordered to status cancelled.

### Capability
`cancel_lapsed_tire_order_8987209f` cancels a customer's ordered tire set that was never mounted and pays its cancellation refund. One call moves the set from ordered to cancelled with today's date as its closing date and books one refund entry on the set for the refund reason given, carrying the original purchase ticket number given and returning the money to the tender that paid that ticket. Once booked, the set shows status cancelled and the history shows the refund entry.

### Invocation
An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `cancel_lapsed_tire_order_8987209f` and then calls it.

### Parameters
- `tire_set_id` — reference number of the ordered tire set to cancel, as returned by the tire set lookup (id).
- `ticket_number` — original purchase ticket number of the set being refunded, T- followed by 8 digits, exactly as shown on the set.
- `refund_reason` — why the refund is paid; enum: `satisfaction_trial_return` when the money is returned because the customer gives the set back under the satisfaction trial; `order_cancellation` when the money is returned because an ordered set that was never mounted is cancelled; `none` is never a refund reason and applies only to entries that return no money.
- `amount` — refund paid on the cancelled order, in USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

### Return
A receipt with `tire_set_id`, `status` (the set's new status, cancelled), `closed_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `refund_event_id` (reference number of the refund entry), `ticket_number` (original purchase ticket refunded), `payment_method` (tender the refund goes back to) and `amount` (USD refunded). A returned `refund_event_id` means the cancellation and the refund were booked.
